title: Credit score: the two that matter (Short)

lines.say: What actually moves your credit score?

lines.cap: Payment history is 35%. Amounts owed, 30%. Together, that's most of it.
lines.say: Payment history is thirty-five percent. Amounts owed, thirty. Together, that's most of it.

scene.text: Autopay the minimum. Never be late.

lines.say: Autopay at least the minimum, so you're never late.

lines.cap: And use less of your limit. A $3,200 balance on a $5,000 limit is 64%. Paying it down drops that every month.
lines.say: And use less of your limit. A thirty-two hundred balance on a five thousand limit is sixty-four percent. Paying it down drops that every month.
